findings.concern: User configuration could become a name-matching escape hatch across unrelated ABI mechanisms.
findings.resolution: The registry has a closed mechanism vocabulary; users select bounded roots/targets while implementation owns witness chains and result ceilings.

findings.concern: A resolved sidecar could be mistaken for a graph edge or a MUST path.
findings.resolution: The specification forbids SQLite/call-graph mutation and retains MAY_TOP(ffi) pending a separately reviewed graph contract.

findings.concern: Callbacks need a different direction of proof from exports.
findings.resolution: callback_registration is frontier-only in v1 and cannot emit a target without a future receiver-proof mechanism.

open: Implementation starts with a strict parser/validator, then adapts only the two existing resolved mechanism families.
